messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "dose can be adjusted every two weeks for high blood pressure"
set: ["dose can be adjusted every two weeks for high blood pressure", "taken as one dose or split into two for high blood pressure", "adjusted according to blood pressure response", "dose cannot be adjusted with available strengths", "monitor for blood pressure changes when dose changes", "continue use for high blood pressure even if feeling fine", "monitor for blood pressure changes", "reassess blood pressure after a few weeks", "dose should be doubled every two weeks to the highest dose you tolerate, up to 200 mg once a day", "high blood pressure often causes no symptoms", "dose may need to be adjusted as diet changes", "40 mg every 12 weeks", "can be taken every day of the menstrual cycle", "dose should be adjusted in patients with reduced kidney function", "dose not increased more than once every 4 weeks", "keep taking even when feeling fine if being treated for high blood pressure"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
